# Implementation Log

<!-- This template records results; it does not define additional requirements.
Process and gates: [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).
Skill quality requirements: [Skill standard](../skill-standard.md).
Keep entries proportional: short prose and evidence links are enough; combine related
fields and mark non-applicable details with a reason. Preserve identifiers, source
links, applicable checks, and audit evidence. Adjust links in the created artifact. -->

## Language

Write this implementation log in the operator's language.

## Log ID

`implementation-log-<YYYYMMDD>-<N>`

## Related Issue

<!-- Include the matching issue ID and relative path. -->

## Related Plan

<!-- Include the matching plan ID and relative path, when a plan exists. -->

## Operator Request

<!-- Summarize the request that started or changed this implementation, its authority, and current scope. Link accepted inputs and relevant baseline/candidate snapshots. -->

## Summary

<!-- Briefly summarize what was implemented. -->

## Changes Made

<!-- List changed files and purposes. For accepted audit recommendations, use a compact
entry or link for each applicable item:
recommendation -> original failure path/protected invariant -> source/owner ->
affected surfaces -> change -> falsifier/closure evidence -> status.
Use implementation-discipline for remediation status semantics. -->

## Decisions

<!-- Record important implementation decisions and rationale. -->

## Verification Performed

<!-- List checks performed, results, and raw evidence locators. Distinguish structural, behavioral, and independent evidence; state unverified boundaries and reasons for omitted checks. -->

### Skill Review Evidence (when applicable)

<!-- For substantial skill changes, record the claimed capability and anti-claims,
author self-check result, stable reviewed snapshot/scope, independent auditor and
assurance evidence, verdict/report locator, and blind forward-test rationale/results
or justified omission under the owning rules. skill-reviewer owns review verdicts;
author self-check or successful compilation is not an independent PASS.
For behavioral trials, link inputs, raw outputs, and evaluation evidence; record
who had access to criteria and which context/files the executor could see. State
exposure limits and whether the evidence supports a blind or guided claim.
Keep detail proportional and link existing evidence instead of duplicating it. -->

## Deviations From Plan

<!-- Document any divergence from the plan and why it was necessary. -->

## Side Effects

<!-- Document observed or possible side effects, including destructive side effects, and the applicable rollback or neutralization path. -->

## Follow-up

<!-- List remaining work, open questions, or deferred risks. -->

## Final Status

<!-- State implementation status and remaining limits separately from any independent audit verdict. Reference the applicable audit report; do not infer independent PASS from author checks. -->
